'''Duro Delta 12''', also known as '''DD 12''', was an orbital [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] that was located in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], DD 12 was a flourishing construction yard, but following the [[Declaration of a New Order|ascent]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], operations in the shipyard were reduced to half the yard's capacity and many semi-independent sections of the yard were either powered down or abandoned entirely. However, large amounts of traffic continued to flow to the yard's main sections, in the form of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] bringing in [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] for repairs, deliveries of materials for use in the construction of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and shipments of cargo that were temporarily stored in the yard while awaiting transport. As a consequence of the mix of seclusion and high traffic that the yard offered, by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] DD 12 had became a popular place for clandestine meetings. The yard was regularly used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to meet with Rebel sympathizers from among the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and during one such meeting in the depthes of DD 12, the [[Duro Shipwrights' Guild|Duro Shipwrights Guild]] pledged its support to the Alliance.
